explanation: Build a valid prefix recursively. Add an opening parenthesis while any remain and add a closing parenthesis only when an unmatched opening is available. Immutable strings are extended at each step.
timeComplexity: O(n²·Cn) upper bound including string copying, for n pairs and Catalan number Cn outputs
spaceComplexity: O(n²) active prefix strings plus O(n·Cn) output
